description: Procedure for UE to update its registration with the network.

properties.description: UE is in idle mode.
UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
AMF receives the REGISTRATION REQUEST message from UE.
AMF handles NSSAI compatibility if applicable.
AMF stops relevant timers (T3513, T3565).
AMF stores UE capabilities.
AMF allocates or reallocates a 5G-GUTI if needed.
AMF includes CAG information in Registration Accept if UE supports CAG and needs update
AMF starts timer T3550 under certain conditions.
AMF may include a new TAI list.
AMF may include a list of equivalent PLMNs or SNPNs.
AMF may include new service area restrictions.
AMF handles MICO mode if applicable.
AMF may include timer values.
AMF sets bits in the 5GS network feature support IE.
AMF activates congestion control if needed.
AMF handles inter-system changes (S1 to N1).
AMF initiates the UUAA-MM procedure if applicable.
AMF provides parameters related to MINT, if supported.
AMF handles the Forbidden TAIs parameters from satellite NG-RAN
AMF shall include the Feature authorization indication IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
AMF includes the 5GS registration result IE.
AMF includes Allowed NSSAI, Rejected NSSAI as needed.
AMF includes the Network slicing indication IE if the UDM has indicated that the subscription data for network slicing has changed
If the UE indicates support for network slice usage control and the AMF determines to provide the on-demand NSSAI, the AMF shall include the On-demand NSSAI IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
AMF may include a new configured NSSAI.

If a new configured NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN is included, the subscription information includes the NSSRG information, and the NSSRG bit in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message is set to: NSSRG supported, then the AMF shall include the NSSRG information in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
AMF handles PDU sessions based on requested NSSAI.

The REGISTRATION ACCEPT message includes the 5GS registration result IE with the NSSAA to be performed indicator set to indicate that the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure will be performed by the network, if the allowed NSSAI is not included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

If the UE has set the NSAG bit to NSAG supported in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message over 3GPP access, the AMF may include the NSAG information IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
AMF includes Alternative NSSAI IE.

If the UE has indicated the support for partial network slice and the AMF determines one or more S-NSSAI(s) in the requested NSSAI are to be included in the partially allowed NSSAI as specified in subclause 4.6.2.11, the AMF shall include the Partially allowed NSSAI IE in the Registration accept type 6 IE container IE of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
AMF handles the Uplink data status IE.
AMF handles Single access PDU sessions and MA PDU sessions based on requested NSSAI.
AMF includes an EPS bearer context status IE if interworking with EPS is supported.

If the UE included S1 mode supported indication in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, the AMF supporting interworking with EPS shall set the IWK N26 bit to either: interworking without N26 interface not supported if the AMF supports N26 interface or interworking without N26 interface supported if the AMF does not support N26 interface in the 5GS network feature support IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
AMF sets the MPS/MCS indicator bits.
AMF may delay releasing the NAS signalling connection.
AMF shall include the Negotiated DRX parameters IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message and replace any stored Negotiated DRX parameter and use it for the downlink transfer of signalling and user data.

If the UE has indicated support for service gap control in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, a service gap time value is available in the 5GMM context, the AMF may include the T3447 value IE set to the service gap time value in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
AMF shall include the ciphering key data in the Ciphering key data IE of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message

AMF shall determine the negotiated UE paging probability information for the UE, store it in the 5GMM context of the UE, and if the UE does not have an active emergency PDU session, the AMF shall include it in the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message
AMF stores the Start of unavailability period value and the Unavailability period duration
AMF shall determine the PLMN with disaster condition.

If the UE supporting the reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change receives the RAN timing synchronization IE with the RecReq bit set to Reconnection requested in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

If the UE indicates support of the RAT utilization control in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message over 3GPP access and the network decides to apply the RAT utilization control, the AMF shall include the RAT utilization control IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
If the UE operating as MBSR receives the MBSRAI field of the Feature authorization indication IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
AMF sends REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
UE handles TAI list.
UE handles equivalent PLMN and SNPN lists.
UE handles service area restrictions.
UE handles MICO indication.
UE handles timers (T3512, Non-3GPP de-registration timer).
UE sends REGISTRATION COMPLETE if required.
The UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge the successful update of the network slicing information.

The UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the operator-defined access category definitions or the extended local emergency numbers list or the CAG information list.
The UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE.
The UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the UE radio capability ID IE or the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE.
UE updates CAG information list and performs cell selection if necessary.
UE starts timer T3448 if received.
UE handles S1 mode operation.
The UE shall store the alternative NSSAI as specified in subclause 4.6.2.2.
UE handles network slicing related data, deletes network slicing information
The UE receiving the rejected NSSAI in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message takes the following actions based on the rejection cause in the rejected S-NSSAI(s).

The UE that has indicated the support for network slice-specific authentication and authorization receiving the pending NSSAI in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message shall store the S-NSSAI(s) in the pending NSSAI as specified in subclause 4.6.2.2.
The UE, upon receiving the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with the LADN information IE, shall delete its old LADN information (if any) and store the received new LADN information.

UE shall locally delete all those QoS flow descriptions and all associated QoS rules, if any, which are associated with inactive EPS bearer contexts as indicated by the AMF in the EPS bearer context status IE.

UE stores the received RAT utilization control information together with the PLMN identity of the current PLMN in the list of PLMNs with associated RAT restrictions and replace the previously stored one associated with the current PLMN, if any, with the newly received RAT utilization control information.

If the UE operating as MBSR receives the MBSRAI field of the Feature authorization indication IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, the UE NAS layer informs the lower layers of the status of MBSR authorization as specified in subclause 5.35A.4 of 3GPP TS 23.501 [8].

If the ESI bit of the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message is set to equivalent SNPNs supported, and the serving SNPN changes, the UE shall determine the SNPN identity of the RSNPN from the NID received in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message and the MCC and the MNC of the new 5G-GUTI.

If the UE supporting the reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change receives the RAN timing synchronization IE with the RecReq bit set to Reconnection requested in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

If the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration IE, then the UE shall store the included truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration and return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration.

If the UE receives the Unavailability configuration IE with a value of the unavailability period duration in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, then the UE may either delete a UE determined value and start using the received value, or use a UE determined value.

If the UE is not in NB-N1 mode, the UE has set the RACS bit to RACS supported in the 5GMM Capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, and the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message includes a UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE set to Network-assigned UE radio capability IDs deletion requested or a UE radio capability ID IE.
Stores new values for Negotiated DRX parameters IE, Negotiated NB-N1 mode DRX parameters IE and Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE.
UE is successfully registered.
AMF stops timer T3550 and changes to state 5GMM-REGISTERED upon REGISTRATION COMPLETE
AMF is successfully registered
